name: CSU East Bay VITA
description: Free virtual tax prep via Zoom for adjusted gross income of $89,000 or less
fullDescription: CSU East Bay's accounting students provide free virtual tax preparation through the VITA program for California taxpayers with adjusted gross income of $89,000 or less.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free virtual tax preparation via Zoom
- Available for adjusted gross income up to $89,000
- Federal and California state tax returns
- IRS-certified student preparers supervised by faculty
- Not available for married filing separately, digital asset transactions, or other out-of-scope returns
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the CSU East Bay VITA website to check eligibility
2. Email vita@csueastbay.edu to schedule an appointment
3. Gather your tax documents (Social Security numbers/ITINs, W-2s, 1099s, 1098-T, etc.)
4. Attend your Zoom appointment
5. Review and sign your return electronically
keywords: CSU East Bay, VITA, virtual tax preparation, Zoom tax help, free tax filing, student preparers, Hayward, Alameda County
